description: Close is a CRM and sales engagement platform for managing leads, contacts, activities, and custom sales data.
api_breadth: Offers capabilities to read and write leads, contacts, activities, custom data, webhooks, user profile endpoints, and MCP server tools.
mcp_evidence: Close provides an official remote MCP server at https://mcp.close.com/mcp with HTTP Streamable and OAuth 2.0 DCR support, as well as API key authentication with configurable scopes (mcp.read, mcp.write_safe, mcp.write_destructive).
blocker: None. API keys are directly accessible via Settings -> Developer -> API Keys, and free dev/secondary testing organizations are available.

evidence.title: Authentication with API keys
evidence.supports: API key creation under Settings -> Developer -> API Keys, HTTP Basic authentication structure, and API base URL (https://api.close.com/api/v1).
evidence.excerpt: API keys can be created and managed in your Close account under Settings → Developer → API Keys... API keys use HTTP Basic client side authentication. To use it, send your HTTP requests with an Authorization header that contains the word Basic followed by a space and a base64-encoded string composed of an api key followed by a colon.

evidence.title: Build an Integration | Close | Developer API Documentation
evidence.supports: OAuth 2.0 authentication, REST API access, webhooks, and developer access via free secondary or Dev organizations.
evidence.excerpt: There are two ways to authenticate with the Close REST API or MCP server: API keys... and OAuth 2.0... Integration partners who don’t use Close in their own sales process can request a free Dev organization by emailing support@close.com.

evidence.title: Close MCP Server | Close | Developer API Documentation
evidence.supports: Official Close remote MCP server availability, endpoint, authentication protocols, and MCP scopes.
evidence.excerpt: The MCP server URL is https://mcp.close.com/mcp and has “HTTP Streamable” and “OAuth 2.0 Dynamic Client Registration (DCR)” support... authenticate using an API key and include the following headers in your request: Close-API-Key: {{ Your Close API Key }}.

evidence.title: Close Developer Platform | Close | Developer API Documentation
evidence.supports: REST API functionality for pushing leads, contacts, activities, and custom data into Close.
evidence.excerpt: Push leads, contacts, activities, and custom data into Close from your website or other systems via the REST API.

research_notes: Close offers well-documented developer tools including API Key basic auth, OAuth 2.0 app registration, a full REST API, and an official remote MCP server.
